invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieMergeHandle created by a factory method and should not return null in normal operation.
The return type of the method is HoodieMergeHandle, ensuring result is an instance of this class.
instantTime is passed directly into the factory method, and a null would likely cause an exception or misbehavior.
partitionPath is used as an argument for the factory, suggesting it should be non-null.
fileId is used in the factory method; it being null could cause failures downstream.
